paper_route: Revised main-track candidate after fair-control and reporting fixes
claim_scope: Real-data causal validation is now carried by Favorita promotion; PRF is semi-synthetic only; M6 completed the fair-control D0/D1/D2 protocol on DLinear, PatchTST, TiDE, Transformer, and TimeXer, with strict seed-level pass on DLinear, PatchTST, TiDE, and Transformer and a TimeXer mean-pass stability caveat. The remaining claim boundary is that this is an intervention-oriented scenario-forecasting submission under stated assumptions, not a full leaderboard SOTA claim across every TSF benchmark.

M6.label: PASS_FAIR_CONTROL_PROTOCOL
M6.fairness: D0/D1/D2 share item static controls; D1/D2 share item-specific response capacity

headline_claims: H1 CONFIRMED (scoped): observational MISO estimators exhibit material scenario bias (D0 sign-error rate 100.0% at calibrated γ̂), while observational WMAPE is blind to the failure.
H3 CONFIRMED: DoCast (D2) reduces elasticity RMSE by 65.7% vs D0 at 0.45% observational accuracy cost — hidden-confounder stress-test improvement in the current linear MISO ablation.

FAIR-CONTROL CHECK: when D0/D1/D2 all receive item controls, RMSE is 0.1927/0.5103/0.2151; D2 reduces RMSE vs the fair D1 structural head by 58.1%. The controlled D0 result is reported separately and is not claimed as an orthogonal-loss win.

H5 REAL A-TYPE: Favorita promotion NEE 0.1051 < D0 NEE 0.3088 (66.0% reduction; unit Wilcoxon p=8.78e-15) against matched within-unit ATT; mean paired NEE delta 0.0496 (95% CI [0.04, 0.0596]); robustness grid median reduction 60.7%, max p=0.0049.
H5 REAL A-TYPE #2: M5 markdown NEE 0.0264 < D0 NEE 0.0775 (65.9% reduction; unit Wilcoxon p=1.29e-06; mean paired NEE delta 0.0129, 95% CI [0.0096, 0.0163]).
PRF SEMI-SYNTHETIC: DoCast Kendall-τ 1.000 on candidate price plans (decision stress test, not counted as real-data validation).

M6 FAIR-CONTROL BACKBONE PROTOCOL: strict seed-level pass on DLinear (74.4% θ-RMSE reduction vs fair D1, -1.04% mean WMAPE change), PatchTST (17.3% θ-RMSE reduction vs fair D1, 2.23% mean WMAPE change), TiDE (37.0% θ-RMSE reduction vs fair D1, -3.08% mean WMAPE change), Transformer (57.1% θ-RMSE reduction vs fair D1, -23.95% mean WMAPE change); boundary: TimeXer mean-pass boundary (27.2% θ-RMSE reduction, 2.14% mean WMAPE change, 2/3 seeds pass, max seed WMAPE change 6.41%)
backbones_evaluated: TimeXer (M6 mean pass; strict stability caveat)
